title: finding(plugin-map/docs): `ObjectMap.tsx`'s docblock says `ObjectView` / `ListView` DERIVE their flatten whitelist from the schema — they hand-write it, and their own docblocks say they must
body:
Path: none | docblock 描述架构所禁止的事 | 纯文档措辞

`ObjectMap.tsx`'s docblock states that `ObjectView` / `ListView` **derive** their flatten whitelist from `ObjectMapConfigSchema`, 「imported from `@object-ui/types/zod`」, so 「all three sites read one canonical set of keys」. They do ⛔ **not**, and by the two files' own accounts they deliberately **must not** — a real runtime import of that specifier from either file fails the alias-closure gate.

## The claim, verbatim, seat-verified at source on objectui `origin/main` `1ed2e69fa`

```
packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:133-136
 * `ObjectView` / `ListView` derive their own flatten whitelist from this exact
 * schema (imported from `@object-ui/types/zod`, already a dependency of both —
 * no new coupling to this package's heavier `react-map-gl` / `maplibre-gl`
 * dependencies), so all three sites read one canonical set of keys.
```

## The two files say the opposite, in their own docblocks

```
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:51   * `@object-ui/types/zod`'s actual barrel file (`zod/index.zod.ts` — a
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:56   * an explicit `@object-ui/types/zod` entry since PR #5156). `ObjectMap.tsx`
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:93 * (same two lines)
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:98
```

⇒ ⭐ **all four occurrences of that specifier in those two files are inside comments** explaining why the import is not made. There is ⛔ no import statement. The relayed reason — a real import from either file fails `examples/console-starter/test/vite-alias-closure.test.ts` — is the objectui#9950 dev's, ⛔ relayed and not re-measured by this seat.

## ⚠️ ⛔ A CORRECTION to the probe this finding arrived with

The objectui#9950 dev reported the probe as 「occurrences of `@object-ui/types/zod` … = **0 and 0**; lit control, occurrences of `ObjectMapConfig` … = **2 and 2**」.

Re-run by this seat on the base `1ed2e69fa`: `@object-ui/types/zod` = **2 and 2**, and `ObjectMapConfig` = **5 and 5**.

⇒ ⭐ the **conclusion stands and the instrument did not**. A bare occurrence count answers a different question than the one that matters: the right reading is 「zero **import statements**」, and the two prose mentions per file are the **lit control** — they prove the files are talking about that specifier deliberately rather than being unaware of it. ⛔ Publishing 「0 and 0」 would have put a falsifiable number in a card whose point is that a docblock carries a false one.

## Class (a) — a documentation ERROR, ⛔ not incompleteness

The distinction the three-class test turns on: this is not a missing member or a thin explanation. It is a **false mechanism claim** — it tells a reader the three sites share one derived source, so a reader who adds a key to `ObjectMapConfigSchema` will believe two of the three update themselves. ⭐ That is precisely the belief objectui#9950 was filed about: two hand-listed whitelists silently missing `style`.

⇒ ⛔ the docblock is not merely stale — it describes the mechanism whose **absence** is the sibling card's defect.

## ⚠️ Read it AFTER objectui#9950 lands

PR objectui#9999 replaces both hand-listed whitelists with a total spelling table whose coverage is a **compile** error. ⇒ the correct replacement text depends on what those two files end up doing, and writing it before that lands would describe a third state that never existed.

## Provenance

Surfaced by the objectui#9950 dev, which fenced `ObjectMap.tsx` out of its declared face as read-only and reported rather than rode in. ⛔ Filed apart from objectui#10002 (the `warnOnTopLevelStyleUrl` remedy text): same file, different defect — that one misprescribes to an **author**, this one misdescribes a **mechanism** to a maintainer.

## Dedupe words

`ObjectMap docblock derive claim false` · `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS derived comment wrong` · `ListView ObjectView do not import types zod` · `alias-closure walker zod barrel` · `false mechanism claim ObjectMap`

## Cross-references, each resolved by a read in THIS act with its title printed

- objectui#9950 — *[finding] ObjectMapConfigSchema declares `style`, and both hand-listed flatteners drop it by type…* (open, `pm:dispatched`; PR objectui#9999 — the defect this docblock's false mechanism made invisible)
- objectui#10002 — the `warnOnTopLevelStyleUrl` remedy text in the same file (⛔ a different defect, ⛔ not a duplicate)
